'''Moon''' is a 4on4 TDM map by {{player|alice|flag=se}}, with the diverging feature from standard itemisation of 2 Lightning Guns, and 1 Rocket Launcher. The layout offer alot of verticality with strategic positions. The map has as much as 5 height levels in the center area. Locs are made for the map by {{player|Flintheart|flag=se}}

''Set in the distant moonbase area of the Wallace Corporation, where the brand of DiJi manufactures the Joi replicant in year 2049. by the Wallace Corporation''

* The map has a variation designed for 1on1/2on2: [[Zite]]
